subject: Oceanography
title: Polar Shipping Routes
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Polar Shipping Routes.

hook.text: Russia's Northern Sea Route is now ice-free for months—cutting shipping time from Asia to Europe by 40%.

buildup.text: As ice retreats, new shipping lanes open across the top of the world—shorter and cheaper than southern routes.

discovery.text: Cargo traffic on the Northern Sea Route has grown tenfold since 2013—reaching 34 million tons in 2022.

twist.text: More ships mean oil spill risks, underwater noise pollution, and disturbance to marine mammals.

climax.text: Rescue capability is minimal in polar waters—a major accident could be catastrophic and unreachable.

punchline.text: Cheaper shipping routes come at a cost the Arctic can't afford.

quiz.question: What environmental risks do polar shipping routes create?
options: Oil spills, noise pollution, and wildlife disturbance
